# Artfinder

> Artfinder is an online art marketplace connecting independent artists with collectors seeking original paintings, sculptures, prints, and photography at affordable prices.

Artfinder provides a curated platform for discovering and purchasing original artwork across multiple mediums and subject categories. The marketplace features work from thousands of independent artists worldwide, with advanced filtering options by medium, price range, and artistic subject matter.

## Core Shopping & Browsing

- [Buy Original Art, Wall Art & Art Prints | Artfinder](https://www.artfinder.com): Artfinder homepage: art marketplace for original paintings, sculptures, prints, photography from independent artists.
- [Original art for sale](https://www.artfinder.com/art): Main art browsing and shopping page with filtering by medium, price, and artist.
